articles.title: Venezuela quake death toll passes 4,000 as scale of recovery effort looms large
articles.summary: The Venezuelan government reported 4,118 people killed and 16,740 injured in twin earthquakes on June 24 that flattened districts in La Guaira state. Thousands are listed as missing. The UN and President Delcy Rodríguez have called for financial help. Nearly 17,000 injured and thousands more are listed as missing amid calls by UN and president Delcy Rodríguez for financial helpThe death toll in Venezuela’s devastating twin earthquakes has topped 4,000, the government said on Friday. At least 4,118 people were killed and 16,740 injured in the back-to-back quakes on 24 June that flattened entire districts in the coastal state of La Guaira, Venezue.

articles.title: US Senators, Administration Agree To Advance Russia Sanctions Bill; Kyiv Hails Move
articles.summary: US senators and the Trump administration have agreed to advance a bill imposing tougher economic penalties on Russia and countries supporting its war economy. The move is aimed at Moscow's continued aggression. Kyiv has welcomed the decision. A bipartisan group of US senators said they had reached an agreement with the Trump administration to advance long-delayed legislation aimed at imposing tougher economic penalties on Russia and countries that continue to support Moscow’s war economy.

articles.title: US Expands Pressure Campaign With New Sanctions On Iran's Financial Networks
articles.summary: The US has imposed new sanctions targeting an Iranian businessman and several exchange houses. The move aims to disrupt a global financial network used by Iran's Supreme Leader. The sanctions seek to limit Tehran's access to foreign currency. The United States imposed sweeping new sanctions targeting an Iranian businessman accused of managing a global financial network for Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei and several exchange houses that Washington says have helped Tehran evade sanctions and maintain access to foreign currency.

articles.title: Crowds Brawl With Recruiters In Lviv In Latest Clash Over Mobilization

Authorities opened a criminal investigation. Russia was accused of using propaganda to incite unrest. A brawl between Ukrainian military recruiters and local residents erupted in Lviv, western Ukraine, on July 8, as the officers were detaining men who had failed to register for duty.

articles.title: Species’ ingenious survival strategies no match for human destruction, red list reveals
articles.summary: This year's red list of endangered species reveals human activities are overwhelming the survival strategies of many species. Desert frogs, snails in extreme ocean depths, and species threatened by mining are among those newly classified as endangered, highlighting the impact of human destruction. Newly endangered animals include desert frogs and snails in extreme ocean depths, both threatened by miningLife has colonised every corner of the planet by evolving ingenious survival strategies but these are increasingly being overwhelmed by destructive human activities, this year’s red list of endangered species has revealed. Many snails, limpets and clams have adapted to life at crushing depths.

articles.title: Rift Over World War II-Era Killings Rocks Crucial Ukraine-Poland Ties
articles.summary: Poland and Ukraine's ties are strained over World War II-era killings at a crucial time in Ukraine's defense against Russia. Poland, steeped in bad memories of the 1939 Nazi-Soviet invasion and decades of dominance from Moscow after World War II, is a firm backer of Ukraine’s defense against Russia. But a flare-up over their own bloody history is threatening ties at a crucial time -- and could have wide repercussions.

articles.title: Diplomats go virtual to witness Gaza displacement site up close
articles.summary: Representatives from 12 countries conducted a "virtual diplomatic field visit" to a Gaza displacement site. They heard from residents about their pressing needs. The UN facilitated the virtual tour. Representatives from 12 countries carried out a “virtual diplomatic field visit” to a displacement site in the Gaza Strip and heard from some of the residents about their pressing needs, the United Nations said on Thursday.

articles.title: Remembering the Srebrenica genocide: ‘Fear is all that kept me moving’
articles.summary: The United Nations paused to remember the over 8,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys killed in Srebrenica in July 1995. The town's women and survivors were left to rebuild their lives after the genocide. The UN marked the event to honor the victims and their families. The United Nations paused on Wednesday to remember the more than 8,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys killed in the town of Srebrenica in July 1995, and the women and survivors left to rebuild their lives in the aftermath.

He deplored the violence in eastern DR Congo. The conflict has resulted in numerous casualties. UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk urged the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group to cease hostilities as he deplored recent civilian deaths on Thursday.

articles.title: US-Iran war leaves shipping at near-standstill in Hormuz again
articles.summary: The US-Iran war brought shipping to a near-standstill in the Strait of Hormuz, stranding 6,000 seafarers. Renewed hostilities between the United States and Iran reportedly brought shipping to a near-standstill in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, leaving around 6,000 seafarers stranded aboard hundreds of vessels and Gulf countries on high alert for further attacks. articles.summary: पाकिस्तानी सेना ने बलूचिस्तान में 75 विद्रोहियों को मार गिराया है। यह कार्रवाई आतंकवाद और विद्रोह को बढ़ते हुए रोकने के लिए की गई है। बलूचिस्तान में विद्रोही अक्सर पाकिस्तानी सेना और पुलिस पर हमले करते हैं। पाकिस्तान (Pakistan) में आतंकवाद (Terrorism) ही नहीं, कुछ प्रांतों में लोगों का विद्रोह भी बढ़ता जा रहा है। सरकार और सेना से नाराज़गी की वजह से विद्रोहियों की संख्या बढ़ रही है।

articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट में एक याचिकाकर्ता ने अभद्र बर्ताव किया, लेकिन जजों ने उसके खिलाफ कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की. कोर्ट ने याचिकाकर्ता की मानसिक दशा को देखते हुए यह निर्णय लिया. जस्टिस केवी विश्वनाथन और जस्टिस आलोक अराधे की बेंच ने लिखित आदेश जारी किया. सुप्रीम कोर्ट में शुक्रवार (10 जुलाई, 2026) को एक याचिकाकर्ता ने बेहद अभद्र बर्ताव किया, लेकिन जजों ने उदारता दिखाते हुए उसके खिलाफ कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की.

articles.title: बरसात में उखड़ी सड़क पर NHAI सख्त, दिल्ली-देहरादून इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर की गुणवत्ता जांच के लिए SIT गठित
articles.summary: दिल्ली-देहरादून इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर पर सड़क की गुणवत्ता खराब होने पर NHAI ने SIT गठित किया. प्राधिकरण ने शुक्रवार को आधिकारिक बयान जारी कर कहा कि गुणवत्ता जांच के लिए विशेष जांच दल बनाया गया है. यह निर्णय सड़क के किनारों पर गड्ढे और धंसाव सामने आने के बाद लिया गया. दिल्ली-देहरादून इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर पर पहली ही बरसात में सड़क किनारों पर गड्ढे और धंसाव सामने आने के बाद उठे सवालों के बीच भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (NHAI) ने गुणवत्ता जांच के लिए विशेष जांच दल (SIT) गठित कर दिया है.

articles.title: सीजफायर खत्म होने से बढ़ा वर्ल्ड वार का खतरा! जानें कौन सा देश अमेरिका-ईरान के बीच सुलह कराने फिर
articles.summary: कतर के वार्ताकार ईरान गए हैं और अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप के समझौता खत्म के ऐलान के बाद तनाव को कम करने की कोशिशें कर रहे हैं. यह दावा सीएनएन ने अपनी एक रिपोर्ट में किया है. कतर की कोशिश से वर्ल्ड वार का खतरा कम हो सकता है. कतर की तरफ से एक बार फिर ईरान और अमेरिका के बीच तनाव को कम करने की कोशिश की जा रही है.
